name: Sensitive file access guard
summary: Block deterministic access to credential files, private keys, and environment secret files.
description: A framework-agnostic deterministic policy core with a Claude Code PreToolUse adapter. It inspects bounded structured paths, static shell file operands, and filesystem aliases without reading file contents or exposing submitted paths.
refuses: It does not read, print, copy, redact, or transform the contents of protected files.
It does not treat a non-match as proof that a path or command is safe.
It does not accept project-controlled configuration or a hidden bypass for protected paths.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate file-access intent and bounded filesystem alias metadata before a protected operation runs.
